title: text_import: don't initialize array elements twice.
description:
Some compilers warn about it with -Winitializer-overrides, and default
to setting that.

notes.body: enabled an automatic merge when the pipeline for fd39930f4092423c472a3a613afef4f28a88724f succeeds

commits_data.message:
text_import: don't initialize array elements twice.

Some compilers warn about it with -Winitializer-overrides, and default
to setting that.
